The 2026 Laredo Marathon returns Sunday, November 15, in Laredo, with more than 300 runners already registered and hundreds expected to take part overall, according to KGNS.

This year adds two new options alongside the full marathon: a half marathon and a five-person relay, KGNS reported.

Registration costs $100 through November 14 and $120 on race day, according to KGNS. Runners can register online at laredomarathon.com.

The KGNS report did not list a race start time or course route in its article text, so runners should check the official registration site for those details before race day.

Update — November 13, 2026

The City of Laredo says the marathon is two days away, and runners should head to The Outlet Shoppes at Laredo on Saturday, November 14, for packet pickup from noon to 5 p.m. Runners also need to attend one of the mandatory race briefings, at 1 p.m. or 3 p.m. The city is asking the community to come out with signs and cheers for race day on Sunday, November 15.

Source: City of Laredo, Nov. 13, 2026.

Update — November 14, 2026

The City of Laredo says the marathon is now one day away, with more than 700 runners registered for Sunday, November 15. The city is inviting the community to cheer runners on at five designated hype stations: the Laredo Water Museum at 2702 Anna Ave.; Santa Maria Avenue and Shiloh Drive; City Hall at 1110 Houston St.; McPherson Road and Shiloh Drive; and Del Mar Boulevard near Alexander High School. The city asks supporters to bring signs and cheers to help runners through every mile.

Source: City of Laredo, Nov. 14, 2026.

title: 2026 Laredo Marathon Returns Nov. 15 With Half Marathon and Five-Person Relay
